FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 106
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/11/2023
Senate Bill 106 as introduced would further increase the administrative obligations of municipal
courts by expanding the information required to be entered into the municipal court reporting
system, established by Act 2022-425, by January 1, 2025, once the system becomes operational
and could also increase the financial obligations of the Alabama Administrative Office of Courts
by an undetermined amount to update the municipal court reporting system, pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
